text: NeuroArchive is the umbrella contract. Do not create an independent NZA ontology. Preserve R LNA v2 and scalafim-lna-hdf5-0 as explicit, currently distinct profiles; add a backend-neutral acquisition manifest and a Zarr v3 profile for canonical remote access. The live branch lacks the previously proposed response-block source and faithful NIfTI round-trip path, so both are explicit M1 work.
